# DNS Enhancement Proposals

DEPs record API proposals, decisions, alternatives, and compatibility analysis. The [DEP process](../docs/design/common.md#dep-process) defines the layout, required sections, and statuses. [Current design](../docs/design/README.md) remains the specification; accepted DEPs are reflected there before implementation follows them.

Use [the template](./dep-template.md) for a new proposal. Single Markdown files named `dep-<number>-<topic>.md` are the default.
